fields.description: Unique identifier for each normalized order activity event.
fields.name: activity_id
fields.remark: Primary key of the activity dataset.
fields.transform_logic: Use source event_id; if unavailable, generate a deterministic hash of venue_code, trading_date, instrument_id, order_id, event_sequence_no and transaction_timestamp.

fields.description: Business trading date assigned by the market calendar.
fields.name: trading_date
fields.transform_logic: Cast to DATE; for overnight sessions apply the venue trading-calendar cut-off.

fields.allowable_values: Venue master list, e.g. XHKG, XNAS, XNYS
fields.description: Code identifying the exchange, ATS or trading venue.
fields.name: venue_code
fields.transform_logic: Map native venue identifier to ISO 10383 MIC where available.

fields.description: Trading board, market segment or order book segment.
fields.name: market_segment
fields.remark: Useful where a venue operates multiple books.
fields.transform_logic: Trim and standardize to uppercase; map native segment codes to enterprise values.

fields.description: Enterprise identifier for the traded cash-market instrument.
fields.name: instrument_id
fields.transform_logic: Lookup using venue_code and native_symbol/security_id effective at transaction_timestamp.

fields.allowable_values: ISIN, SEDOL, CUSIP or venue security ID
fields.description: Native or industry security identifier used by the venue.
fields.name: security_id
fields.remark: Identifier type should be captured in security_id_type.
fields.transform_logic: Preserve source value; trim whitespace and uppercase when identifier rules require it.

fields.allowable_values: ISIN; SEDOL; CUSIP; RIC; VENUE_ID; OTHER
fields.description: Type of identifier stored in security_id.
fields.name: security_id_type
fields.transform_logic: Map source identifier type to controlled values.

fields.allowable_values: Valid symbol for venue and trading date
fields.description: Venue trading symbol or ticker.
fields.name: symbol
fields.transform_logic: Trim surrounding spaces; preserve venue-significant punctuation and case where required.

fields.description: Trading currency of price fields.
fields.name: currency_code
fields.remark: All monetary price fields use this currency.
fields.transform_logic: Effective-dated lookup by instrument_id and transaction_timestamp.

fields.description: Venue-assigned identifier for the order.
fields.name: order_id
fields.remark: Core key for reconstructing an order lifecycle.
fields.transform_logic: Cast to string and preserve leading zeros.

fields.allowable_values: Valid order_id or source parent identifier
fields.description: Identifier of the parent order for child or routed orders.
fields.name: parent_order_id
fields.remark: May refer to an order outside the same venue feed.
fields.transform_logic: Cast to string; null when no parent relationship exists.

fields.description: Client or broker-assigned order identifier, if provided.
fields.name: client_order_id
fields.transform_logic: Trim; apply masking or tokenization where required by data policy.

fields.description: Market participant or member identifier associated with the order.
fields.name: participant_id
fields.remark: Often unavailable in public market-data feeds.
fields.transform_logic: Standardize through participant reference mapping; mask if access is restricted.

fields.description: Trader or operator identifier associated with order entry.
fields.name: trader_id
fields.transform_logic: Tokenize or pseudonymize according to privacy and surveillance policy.

fields.allowable_values: CLIENT; HOUSE; MARKET_MAKER; PRINCIPAL; AGENCY; UNKNOWN
fields.description: Trading account classification.
fields.name: account_type
fields.transform_logic: Map source account code to controlled enterprise values.

fields.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within the source channel or partition.
fields.name: event_sequence_no
fields.remark: Use with channel_id when sequence resets by channel.
fields.transform_logic: Cast to BIGINT; retain source ordering without resequencing.

fields.description: Identifier of the source feed channel, partition or matching-engine stream.
fields.name: channel_id
fields.transform_logic: Trim and standardize; null only if sequence is globally unique.

fields.description: Timestamp assigned by the venue or matching engine when the event occurred.
fields.name: transaction_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert to UTC; retain nanosecond precision where the platform supports it.

fields.description: Original source timestamp before timezone normalization.
fields.name: source_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Preserve exact source representation for audit and reconciliation.

fields.allowable_values: Timestamp greater than or equal to transaction time, subject to clock differences
fields.description: Timestamp when the event was received by the capture system.
fields.name: receive_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert to UTC; do not overwrite source value.

fields.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the analytical platform.
fields.name: ingestion_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Set by ingestion framework at successful record write.

fields.description: Sortable composite representation of timestamp and sequence for deterministic ordering.
fields.name: event_date_time_key
fields.remark: Derived ordering key; not a substitute for activity_id.
fields.transform_logic: Concatenate UTC transaction_timestamp, zero-padded channel_id where applicable, and zero-padded event_sequence_no.

fields.allowable_values: NEW; MODIFY; CANCEL; EXECUTE; REPLACE; EXPIRE; REJECT; SUSPEND; RESUME; TRADE_CORRECT; TRADE_CANCEL
fields.description: Normalized type of order book activity.
fields.name: activity_type
fields.transform_logic: Map source event code to normalized activity taxonomy.

fields.allowable_values: NEW; PARTIAL_FILL; FILL; CANCELED; REPLACED; PENDING_CANCEL; REJECTED; EXPIRED; RESTATED; TRADE_CORRECT; TRADE_CANCEL; OTHER
fields.description: Normalized execution-report event type.
fields.name: execution_type
fields.remark: Nullable for feeds that provide only book actions.
fields.transform_logic: Map source/FIX ExecType to enterprise values.

fields.allowable_values: NEW; PARTIALLY_FILLED; FILLED; CANCELED; REPLACED; REJECTED; EXPIRED; SUSPENDED; PENDING; UNKNOWN
fields.description: Order status immediately after applying the event.
fields.name: order_status
fields.transform_logic: Map source status; where absent, derive from cumulative quantity, leaves quantity and activity type.

fields.allowable_values: BUY; SELL; SELL_SHORT; SELL_SHORT_EXEMPT; CROSS; UNKNOWN
fields.description: Order side.
fields.name: side
fields.remark: BUY and SELL expected for most cash order books.
fields.transform_logic: Map source side code to controlled values.

fields.allowable_values: MARKET; LIMIT; STOP; STOP_LIMIT; MARKET_ON_OPEN; MARKET_ON_CLOSE; LIMIT_ON_OPEN; LIMIT_ON_CLOSE; PEGGED; ICEBERG; MIDPOINT; OTHER
fields.description: Order pricing or behavior type.
fields.name: order_type
fields.remark: Venue-specific types may be retained in native_order_type.
fields.transform_logic: Map source order type to normalized values.

fields.description: Unmodified venue-specific order type code.
fields.name: native_order_type
fields.transform_logic: Preserve exact source value.

fields.allowable_values: DAY; GTC; IOC; FOK; GTD; AT_OPEN; AT_CLOSE; GOOD_FOR_SESSION; OTHER
fields.description: Instruction controlling how long the order remains active.
fields.name: time_in_force
fields.transform_logic: Map source/FIX TimeInForce code to controlled values.

fields.allowable_values: Valid UTC timestamp after order entry
fields.description: Scheduled expiry time for GTD or time-bounded orders.
fields.name: expire_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert to UTC; null for orders without an explicit expiry time.

fields.allowable_values: Greater than or equal to 0; compliant with tick size
fields.description: Specified limit price for the order.
fields.name: limit_price
fields.remark: Precision should accommodate venue tick sizes.
fields.transform_logic: Cast to decimal in trading currency; null for pure market orders.

fields.description: Trigger price for stop or stop-limit orders.
fields.name: stop_price
fields.transform_logic: Cast to decimal; null unless applicable to order type.

fields.description: Price offset used by a pegged order.
fields.name: peg_offset
fields.transform_logic: Cast to decimal; preserve sign.

fields.allowable_values: PRIMARY; MARKET; MIDPOINT; LAST; BEST_BID; BEST_ASK; OTHER
fields.description: Reference price used for a pegged order.
fields.name: peg_reference
fields.transform_logic: Map source reference code to controlled values.

fields.allowable_values: Greater than 0 for active orders; 0 permitted for terminal administrative events
fields.description: Original or revised total quantity of the order after this event.
fields.name: order_quantity
fields.transform_logic: Cast to decimal and normalize to trading units; apply corporate-action adjustment only in separately adjusted views.

fields.description: Maximum quantity displayed to the market for reserve/iceberg orders.
fields.name: display_quantity
fields.transform_logic: Cast to decimal; null when not supplied or not applicable.

fields.description: Minimum executable quantity condition.
fields.name: minimum_quantity
fields.transform_logic: Cast to decimal; null when no minimum applies.

fields.description: Quantity executed by this activity event.
fields.name: executed_quantity
fields.transform_logic: Set to 0 for non-execution events; cast and normalize to trading units.

fields.description: Total quantity executed for the order up to and including this event.
fields.name: cumulative_executed_quantity
fields.transform_logic: Use source cumulative quantity; if absent, running sum of executed_quantity by order lifecycle in event order.

fields.description: Unexecuted quantity remaining after this event.
fields.name: unfilled_quantity
fields.remark: Should be 0 for filled, canceled, rejected or expired terminal states.
fields.transform_logic: Use source value; otherwise greatest(order_quantity - cumulative_executed_quantity, 0), adjusted for cancel/replace semantics.

fields.description: Price of the execution represented by this event.
fields.name: execution_price
fields.transform_logic: Cast to decimal; null for non-execution events.

fields.description: Volume-weighted average execution price for the order up to this event.
fields.name: average_execution_price
fields.remark: Null when cumulative executed quantity is 0.
fields.transform_logic: Use source value; otherwise cumulative sum(execution_price * executed_quantity) / cumulative_executed_quantity.

fields.description: Venue-assigned identifier for an execution or trade.
fields.name: trade_id
fields.remark: May repeat across venues or trading dates.
fields.transform_logic: Cast to string and preserve leading zeros; null for non-trade events.

fields.description: Identifier linking the buy and sell sides of a matched execution.
fields.name: match_id
fields.transform_logic: Cast to string; preserve source value.

fields.description: Indicates whether the order added or removed displayed liquidity for an execution.
fields.name: liquidity_indicator
fields.transform_logic: Map source liquidity code to controlled values.

fields.description: Price level occupied by the order immediately after the event.
fields.name: book_level
fields.remark: Null for terminal orders or market orders not resting.
fields.transform_logic: Rank distinct active prices by side after applying the event: highest first for BUY, lowest first for SELL.

fields.allowable_values: Positive integer or source priority token
fields.description: Order priority position or venue priority sequence at its price level.
fields.name: priority_sequence
fields.remark: Do not infer if venue allocation is not price-time.
fields.transform_logic: Use source priority where supplied; otherwise derive by price-time priority using accepted timestamp and event sequence, respecting venue rules.

fields.allowable_values: Greater than 0; null when bid book is empty
fields.description: Best displayed bid price immediately after applying the activity event.
fields.name: best_bid_price
fields.transform_logic: Maximum active displayed BUY price after the event for the same venue, instrument and book.

fields.description: Aggregate displayed quantity at best bid immediately after the event.
fields.name: best_bid_quantity
fields.transform_logic: Sum displayed remaining quantity of active BUY orders at best_bid_price after the event.

fields.allowable_values: Greater than 0; null when ask book is empty
fields.description: Best displayed ask price immediately after applying the activity event.
fields.name: best_ask_price
fields.transform_logic: Minimum active displayed SELL price after the event for the same venue, instrument and book.

fields.description: Aggregate displayed quantity at best ask immediately after the event.
fields.name: best_ask_quantity
fields.transform_logic: Sum displayed remaining quantity of active SELL orders at best_ask_price after the event.

fields.description: Midpoint of best bid and best ask after the event.
fields.name: mid_price
fields.transform_logic: When both prices are present, (best_bid_price + best_ask_price) / 2; otherwise null.

fields.description: Absolute bid-ask spread after the event.
fields.name: spread
fields.remark: Flag negative values as crossed-book conditions for review.
fields.transform_logic: When both prices are present, best_ask_price - best_bid_price; otherwise null.

fields.allowable_values: Normally greater than or equal to 0
fields.description: Bid-ask spread expressed in basis points of the midpoint.
fields.name: spread_bps
fields.transform_logic: When mid_price > 0, spread / mid_price * 10000; otherwise null.

fields.description: Indicates whether the order is non-displayed.
fields.name: is_hidden
fields.transform_logic: Map source boolean to Y/N; default N only when feed specification guarantees omitted means displayed.

fields.description: Indicates whether the order has reserve quantity.
fields.name: is_iceberg
fields.transform_logic: Map source boolean; alternatively derive Y when display_quantity is positive and less than order_quantity.

fields.description: Indicates that the activity belongs to an auction or call market phase.
fields.name: is_auction
fields.transform_logic: Map source session/auction indicator to Y/N.

fields.allowable_values: PRE_OPEN; OPENING_AUCTION; CONTINUOUS; CLOSING_AUCTION; POST_CLOSE; HALT; VOLATILITY_AUCTION; OTHER
fields.description: Trading session phase at the event time.
fields.name: session_phase
fields.transform_logic: Effective-time lookup by venue, market segment and transaction_timestamp; prefer explicit source phase when available.

fields.allowable_values: NONE; ALL_OR_NONE; DO_NOT_REDUCE; POST_ONLY; REDUCE_ONLY; SELF_TRADE_PREVENTION; OTHER
fields.description: Special handling or regulatory restriction applied to the order.
fields.name: order_restriction
fields.transform_logic: Map one or more source flags to a delimited controlled list or model separately if multi-valued use is frequent.

fields.description: Identifier used by the venue to prevent self-matching.
fields.name: self_trade_prevention_id
fields.transform_logic: Preserve source value; tokenize if participant-sensitive.

fields.description: Code explaining why an order or request was rejected.
fields.name: reject_reason_code
fields.transform_logic: Map to enterprise reject taxonomy while retaining native code in source payload if needed.

fields.allowable_values: USER_REQUEST; SYSTEM; EXPIRED; CORPORATE_ACTION; REGULATORY; VENUE; OTHER
fields.description: Code explaining cancellation, deletion or expiry.
fields.name: cancel_reason_code
fields.transform_logic: Map source reason to controlled values.

fields.description: Indicates whether the event corrects or reverses a prior event.
fields.name: correction_indicator
fields.transform_logic: Map source boolean; set Y for trade correction or trade cancel events.

fields.description: Identifier of the prior activity being replaced, corrected or canceled.
fields.name: reference_activity_id
fields.transform_logic: Resolve using source reference event/trade/order identifiers; null when no direct parent event exists.

fields.description: Name of the originating feed, gateway or source application.
fields.name: source_system
fields.transform_logic: Populate from ingestion configuration, not from mutable event content.

fields.description: Name of the source file or stream object containing the event.
fields.name: source_file_name
fields.remark: Null for direct streaming sources without file objects.
fields.transform_logic: Populate from ingestion metadata.

fields.description: Record position within the source file or message batch.
fields.name: source_record_no
fields.transform_logic: Populate from parser metadata.

fields.description: Hash used to detect duplicate or changed source records.
fields.name: record_hash
fields.remark: Exclude ingestion timestamps from the hash.
fields.transform_logic: SHA-256 of canonicalized source-system, source object, sequence, timestamp and business fields.

fields.description: Unique identifier for each normalized cash-market trade or execution activity.
fields.name: trading_activity_id
fields.transform_logic: Use source event_id; if absent, create a deterministic SHA-256 hash of venue_code, business_date, instrument_id, trade_id, transaction_timestamp and event_sequence_no.

fields.description: Trading-calendar date to which the execution is assigned.
fields.name: business_date
fields.transform_logic: Cast to DATE and assign using the venue trading calendar and session cut-off.

fields.description: Exchange, ATS or venue where the trade occurred.
fields.name: venue_code
fields.transform_logic: Map native venue code to the enterprise venue code or ISO 10383 MIC.

fields.description: Board or market segment where the trade occurred.
fields.name: market_segment
fields.transform_logic: Trim, uppercase and map to enterprise segment values.

fields.description: Enterprise identifier of the traded instrument.
fields.name: instrument_id
fields.transform_logic: Effective-dated lookup using venue_code and native security identifier at transaction_timestamp.

fields.description: Participant responsible for or associated with the activity, where available.
fields.name: participant_id
fields.remark: Foreign key to account_reference; may be restricted.
fields.transform_logic: Map source participant/member/account identifier to the enterprise participant_id.

fields.description: Buying participant identifier, where disclosed.
fields.name: buy_participant_id
fields.remark: Usually unavailable in anonymous public market data.
fields.transform_logic: Map native identifier to participant_id and apply access controls.

fields.description: Selling participant identifier, where disclosed.
fields.name: sell_participant_id
fields.remark: Usually unavailable in anonymous public market data.
fields.transform_logic: Map native identifier to participant_id and apply access controls.

fields.description: Venue-assigned trade or execution identifier.
fields.name: trade_id
fields.remark: Natural key component with venue_code and business_date.
fields.transform_logic: Cast to string and retain leading zeros.

fields.description: Identifier linking the two sides of a matched transaction.
fields.name: match_id
fields.transform_logic: Preserve source value as string.

fields.description: Order identifier associated with the activity, where order-level data is available.
fields.name: order_id
fields.remark: Joins to order_activity by venue, date and order identifier.
fields.transform_logic: Cast to string and preserve leading zeros.

fields.description: Identifier of the buy order involved in the trade.
fields.name: buy_order_id
fields.transform_logic: Cast to string and preserve leading zeros.

fields.description: Identifier of the sell order involved in the trade.
fields.name: sell_order_id
fields.transform_logic: Cast to string and preserve leading zeros.

fields.description: Source sequence used to order activities deterministically.
fields.name: event_sequence_no
fields.transform_logic: Cast to BIGINT and retain source ordering. Use with channel_id when sequences are channel-specific.

fields.description: Feed channel, partition or matching-engine stream identifier.
fields.name: channel_id
fields.transform_logic: Trim and standardize.

fields.description: Venue or matching-engine timestamp for the activity.
fields.name: transaction_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert to UTC while retaining the highest supported precision.

fields.description: Timestamp when the activity was received by the capture platform.
fields.name: receive_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert to UTC and preserve the raw source value separately if needed.

fields.allowable_values: TRADE; TRADE_REPORT; TRADE_CORRECT; TRADE_CANCEL; BUST; ALLOCATION; NETTING; OTHER
fields.description: Normalized type of trading activity.
fields.name: activity_type
fields.transform_logic: Map source event code to the normalized taxonomy.

fields.allowable_values: FULL_FILL; PARTIAL_FILL; CROSS; AUCTION; BLOCK; ODD_LOT; OFF_BOOK; OTHER
fields.description: Execution classification for the activity.
fields.name: execution_type
fields.transform_logic: Map source execution and trade-condition codes to controlled values.

fields.allowable_values: ACTIVE; CORRECTED; CANCELED; BUSTED; PENDING; REJECTED
fields.description: Post-event status of the trade record.
fields.name: trade_status
fields.transform_logic: Map source status; derive ACTIVE for valid new trades when status is not supplied.

fields.description: Side that initiated the execution.
fields.name: aggressor_side
fields.remark: Do not infer for locked/crossed markets without a defined rule.
fields.transform_logic: Use explicit source indicator; otherwise infer only when the approved methodology can compare trade price with prevailing quotes.

fields.description: Execution price in trade currency.
fields.name: trade_price
fields.transform_logic: Cast to decimal; retain unadjusted market price.

fields.description: Executed quantity in the instrument trading unit.
fields.name: trade_quantity
fields.transform_logic: Cast to decimal and normalize to the instrument trading unit.

fields.description: Gross trade value in trade currency.
fields.name: trade_notional
fields.remark: Use 1 as multiplier only where the instrument reference explicitly defines it.
fields.transform_logic: trade_price multiplied by trade_quantity multiplied by instrument_reference.contract_multiplier.

fields.description: Currency in which the trade price is quoted.
fields.name: trade_currency
fields.transform_logic: Effective-dated lookup by instrument_id; prefer explicit source currency when supplied and validated.

fields.description: Currency in which settlement is expected.
fields.name: settlement_currency
fields.transform_logic: Effective-dated lookup; override only with a valid trade-level settlement instruction.

fields.allowable_values: Valid business date on applicable settlement calendar
fields.description: Expected contractual settlement date.
fields.name: settlement_date
fields.transform_logic: Apply instrument settlement_cycle and advance across open settlement days; use source settlement date when explicitly supplied.

fields.description: Exchange rate from trade_currency to the reporting base currency.
fields.name: fx_rate_to_base
fields.transform_logic: Select the applicable rate by business_date, currency pair, rate_type and validity timestamp.

fields.description: Currency or risk haircut rate applicable to the conversion.
fields.name: haircut_rate
fields.transform_logic: Select from the same effective exchange-rate record used for conversion.

fields.description: Trade notional converted to reporting base currency before haircut.
fields.name: base_notional_before_haircut
fields.remark: Null if no applicable rate is available.
fields.transform_logic: trade_notional multiplied by fx_rate_to_base.

fields.description: Converted trade notional after applying the haircut.
fields.name: base_notional_after_haircut
fields.remark: Confirm haircut direction with the downstream risk policy.
fields.transform_logic: base_notional_before_haircut multiplied by (1 - haircut_rate).

fields.description: Best bid immediately before or at the execution according to the selected snapshot convention.
fields.name: best_bid_price
fields.transform_logic: Select the latest valid order-book state not later than transaction_timestamp and event_sequence_no.

fields.description: Best ask immediately before or at the execution according to the selected snapshot convention.
fields.name: best_ask_price
fields.transform_logic: Select the latest valid order-book state not later than transaction_timestamp and event_sequence_no.

fields.description: Midpoint of the selected best bid and best ask.
fields.name: mid_price
fields.transform_logic: When both quotes are available, (best_bid_price + best_ask_price) / 2; otherwise null.

fields.description: Execution cost relative to prevailing midpoint in basis points.
fields.name: effective_spread_bps
fields.remark: Null when midpoint or aggressor side is unavailable.
fields.transform_logic: For BUY: 2*(trade_price-mid_price)/mid_price*10000; for SELL: 2*(mid_price-trade_price)/mid_price*10000.

fields.description: Source trade-condition codes associated with the activity.
fields.name: trade_condition_codes
fields.transform_logic: Preserve native codes in source order and optionally map them through a trade-condition reference.

fields.description: Indicates an auction execution.
fields.name: is_auction
fields.transform_logic: Map explicit source flag or session phase to Y/N.

fields.description: Indicates that execution occurred outside the central limit order book.
fields.name: is_off_book
fields.transform_logic: Map source venue and trade-condition codes to Y/N.

fields.description: Indicates a correction to an earlier trade.
fields.name: is_correction
fields.transform_logic: Set Y for TRADE_CORRECT; otherwise map source indicator.

fields.description: Identifier of the prior activity corrected, canceled or busted.
fields.name: reference_trading_activity_id
fields.transform_logic: Resolve using original trade reference, venue, date and source sequence.

fields.description: Originating feed, gateway or application.
fields.name: source_system
fields.transform_logic: Populate from ingestion configuration.

fields.description: Source file or stream object containing the activity.
fields.name: source_file_name
fields.transform_logic: Populate from ingestion metadata.

fields.description: Record position in the source file or batch.
fields.name: source_record_no
fields.transform_logic: Populate from parser metadata.

fields.description: UTC timestamp when the record was loaded.
fields.name: ingestion_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Set by ingestion framework at successful write.

fields.description: Hash for duplicate detection and change control.
fields.name: record_hash
fields.transform_logic: SHA-256 of canonical source identifiers, event ordering and business fields.

fields.description: Unique enterprise identifier for an instrument.
fields.name: instrument_id
fields.transform_logic: Use mastered enterprise identifier; do not recycle after delisting.

fields.description: Official or mastered instrument name.
fields.name: instrument_name
fields.transform_logic: Trim whitespace and apply approved naming standard.

fields.description: Abbreviated display name.
fields.name: short_name
fields.transform_logic: Trim and standardize.

fields.allowable_values: EQUITY; ETF; REIT; FUND; WARRANT; RIGHT; DEPOSITARY_RECEIPT; OTHER_CASH
fields.description: High-level asset classification.
fields.name: asset_class
fields.transform_logic: Map source security type to enterprise classification.

fields.description: Detailed security type.
fields.name: security_type
fields.transform_logic: Map source classification to controlled taxonomy.

fields.description: International Securities Identification Number.
fields.name: isin
fields.remark: Unique where assigned, but not used as the enterprise primary key.
fields.transform_logic: Uppercase and validate check digit.

fields.description: Stock Exchange Daily Official List identifier.
fields.name: sedol
fields.transform_logic: Uppercase and validate check digit.

fields.description: CUSIP identifier.
fields.name: cusip
fields.transform_logic: Uppercase and validate check digit where applicable.

fields.description: Primary listing or trading venue.
fields.name: primary_venue_code
fields.transform_logic: Select effective primary listing venue.

fields.description: Primary trading symbol.
fields.name: primary_symbol
fields.transform_logic: Select symbol for primary_venue_code effective on the record date.

fields.description: Currency in which the instrument is quoted.
fields.name: trading_currency
fields.transform_logic: Select effective listing currency.

fields.description: Default settlement currency.
fields.name: settlement_currency
fields.transform_logic: Use explicit settlement currency; if absent, use trading currency only under approved market rules.

fields.description: Issuer country of incorporation.
fields.name: country_of_incorporation
fields.transform_logic: Effective lookup through issuer_id.

fields.description: Country primarily associated with investment risk.
fields.name: country_of_risk
fields.transform_logic: Use mastered risk-country methodology.

fields.description: Enterprise issuer identifier.
fields.name: issuer_id
fields.transform_logic: Link instrument to effective issuer.

fields.description: Standard board-lot quantity.
fields.name: lot_size
fields.transform_logic: Select effective venue lot size.

fields.description: Minimum standard price increment.
fields.name: tick_size
fields.transform_logic: Resolve using venue, instrument and price-band schedule. If variable, store the default and link to a detailed schedule.

fields.description: Number of implied decimal places in encoded prices.
fields.name: price_scale
fields.transform_logic: Cast to integer and validate against venue specification.

fields.description: Number of decimal places allowed for quantity.
fields.name: quantity_scale
fields.transform_logic: Cast to integer.

fields.description: Multiplier used to calculate notional value.
fields.name: contract_multiplier
fields.transform_logic: Use source value; for ordinary cash equities this is commonly 1 when explicitly defined.

fields.description: Regular-way settlement convention.
fields.name: settlement_cycle
fields.transform_logic: Map source cycle to controlled values.

fields.description: First effective listing date.
fields.name: listing_date
fields.transform_logic: Cast to DATE.

fields.description: Last effective listing date.
fields.name: delisting_date
fields.transform_logic: Cast to DATE; null while actively listed.

fields.description: Current mastered status.
fields.name: instrument_status
fields.transform_logic: Map source status to controlled values.

fields.description: Start of validity for this reference version.
fields.name: valid_from_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Use source effective time or mastering timestamp.

fields.description: End of validity for this reference version.
fields.name: valid_to_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Null for current version; otherwise set to the next version start.

fields.description: Indicates the current effective record.
fields.name: is_current
fields.transform_logic: Y when valid_to_timestamp is null, otherwise N.

fields.description: Originating reference-data provider or application.
fields.name: source_system
fields.transform_logic: Populate from mastering lineage.

fields.description: Unique enterprise identifier for a trading participant, member, client or account entity.
fields.name: participant_id
fields.transform_logic: Use mastered enterprise identifier; do not expose raw account numbers as the key.

fields.description: Official or mastered participant name.
fields.name: participant_name
fields.transform_logic: Trim and standardize legal/display name.

fields.description: Abbreviated participant name.
fields.name: participant_short_name
fields.transform_logic: Trim and standardize.

fields.allowable_values: BROKER; DEALER; BANK; MARKET_MAKER; CLIENT; FUND; INTERNAL_DESK; CLEARING_MEMBER; OTHER
fields.description: Classification of participant.
fields.name: participant_type
fields.transform_logic: Map source type to controlled taxonomy.

fields.description: Venue or exchange member code.
fields.name: member_code
fields.transform_logic: Preserve source code and map with venue_code.

fields.description: Venue associated with member_code.
fields.name: venue_code
fields.transform_logic: Map native venue to enterprise code.

fields.description: Legal Entity Identifier.
fields.name: lei
fields.transform_logic: Uppercase and validate format/check digits.

fields.allowable_values: CLIENT; HOUSE; PRINCIPAL; AGENCY; MARKET_MAKER; OMNIBUS; SEGREGATED; UNKNOWN
fields.description: Operational or ownership account type.
fields.name: account_type
fields.transform_logic: Map native account classification to controlled values.

fields.allowable_values: RETAIL; PROFESSIONAL; INSTITUTIONAL; ELIGIBLE_COUNTERPARTY; INTERNAL; UNKNOWN
fields.description: Regulatory or commercial client category.
fields.name: client_category
fields.transform_logic: Map source classification according to governing policy.

fields.description: Participant domicile or registered country.
fields.name: country_code
fields.transform_logic: Standardize to ISO code.

fields.description: Default reporting or account currency.
fields.name: base_currency
fields.transform_logic: Use approved account base currency.

fields.description: Identifier of the participant clearing the activity.
fields.name: clearing_member_id
fields.transform_logic: Resolve effective clearing relationship.

fields.description: Parent entity in the participant hierarchy.
fields.name: parent_participant_id
fields.transform_logic: Resolve effective ownership or operational relationship.

fields.description: Identifier used to aggregate participants for risk controls.
fields.name: risk_group_id
fields.transform_logic: Effective-dated lookup by participant_id.

fields.description: Approved monetary credit limit in limit_currency.
fields.name: credit_limit
fields.transform_logic: Select currently effective approved limit.

fields.description: Currency of credit_limit.
fields.name: limit_currency
fields.transform_logic: Required when credit_limit is populated.

fields.description: Current status.
fields.name: participant_status
fields.transform_logic: Map source status to controlled values.

fields.description: Start of validity for this reference version.
fields.name: valid_from_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Use source effective time or mastering timestamp.

fields.description: End of validity for this reference version.
fields.name: valid_to_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Null for current version.

fields.description: Indicates current effective record.
fields.name: is_current
fields.transform_logic: Y when valid_to_timestamp is null, otherwise N.

fields.description: Originating reference-data provider or application.
fields.name: source_system
fields.transform_logic: Populate from mastering lineage.

fields.description: Business date represented by the calendar row.
fields.name: business_date
fields.remark: Primary key as requested. If multiple venues/calendars are required, consider a composite key with calendar_code.
fields.transform_logic: Cast to DATE.

fields.description: Calendar applied to the date, e.g. venue or settlement calendar.
fields.name: calendar_code
fields.remark: Because business_date is the requested primary key, this design assumes one canonical calendar per date or wide market attributes.
fields.transform_logic: Map source calendar to enterprise code.

fields.description: Venue associated with the calendar row.
fields.name: venue_code
fields.remark: Null for a global/canonical business calendar.
fields.transform_logic: Map native venue identifier.

fields.allowable_values: MONDAY; TUESDAY; WEDNESDAY; THURSDAY; FRIDAY; SATURDAY; SUNDAY
fields.description: Day name for the business date.
fields.name: day_of_week
fields.transform_logic: Derive from business_date.

fields.description: Indicates a business day for the canonical calendar.
fields.name: is_business_day
fields.transform_logic: Map source boolean to Y/N.

fields.description: Indicates whether normal trading is scheduled.
fields.name: is_trading_day
fields.transform_logic: Map source boolean to Y/N.

fields.description: Indicates whether settlement processing is scheduled.
fields.name: is_settlement_day
fields.transform_logic: Map source boolean to Y/N.

fields.description: Indicates a full or partial market holiday.
fields.name: is_holiday
fields.transform_logic: Map source boolean to Y/N.

fields.description: Name of the holiday or special market day.
fields.name: holiday_name
fields.transform_logic: Trim and standardize.

fields.description: Overall trading-session classification.
fields.name: session_type
fields.transform_logic: Map source session to controlled values.

fields.allowable_values: Valid UTC timestamp on or near business_date
fields.description: Scheduled continuous-market open in UTC.
fields.name: market_open_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert local schedule to UTC using effective timezone rules.

fields.description: Scheduled continuous-market close in UTC.
fields.name: market_close_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert local schedule to UTC.

fields.description: Scheduled opening-auction start in UTC.
fields.name: opening_auction_start_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert local schedule to UTC.

fields.description: Scheduled closing-auction end in UTC.
fields.name: closing_auction_end_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert local schedule to UTC.

fields.description: IANA timezone used for local market times.
fields.name: timezone_name
fields.transform_logic: Standardize to IANA timezone name.

fields.description: Previous date where is_business_day = Y.
fields.name: previous_business_date
fields.transform_logic: Select maximum earlier business_date with is_business_day = Y.

fields.description: Next date where is_business_day = Y.
fields.name: next_business_date
fields.transform_logic: Select minimum later business_date with is_business_day = Y.

fields.description: Previous date where is_trading_day = Y.
fields.name: previous_trading_date
fields.transform_logic: Select maximum earlier date with is_trading_day = Y.

fields.description: Next date where is_trading_day = Y.
fields.name: next_trading_date
fields.transform_logic: Select minimum later date with is_trading_day = Y.

fields.description: Indicates last business day of month.
fields.name: month_end_flag
fields.transform_logic: Y when next_business_date falls in a different month, otherwise N.

fields.description: Indicates last business day of quarter.
fields.name: quarter_end_flag
fields.transform_logic: Y when next_business_date falls in a different quarter, otherwise N.

fields.description: Indicates last business day of year.
fields.name: year_end_flag
fields.transform_logic: Y when next_business_date falls in a different year, otherwise N.

fields.description: Originating calendar provider or application.
fields.name: source_system
fields.transform_logic: Populate from mastering lineage.

fields.description: Normalized unique code for an available order type.
fields.name: order_type_code
fields.transform_logic: Use stable enterprise code and do not recycle retired codes.

fields.description: Human-readable order type name.
fields.name: order_type_name
fields.transform_logic: Title-case approved display name.

fields.description: Concise description of pricing behavior and execution conditions.
fields.name: order_type_summary
fields.transform_logic: Maintain an approved business definition.

fields.allowable_values: MARKET; LIMIT; STOP; PEGGED; AUCTION; CONDITIONAL; RESERVE; OTHER
fields.description: High-level category.
fields.name: order_category
fields.transform_logic: Map to controlled category.

fields.allowable_values: NONE; MARKET; LIMIT; STOP; STOP_LIMIT; PEG; MIDPOINT; AUCTION_PRICE
fields.description: Primary price instruction.
fields.name: price_instruction
fields.transform_logic: Map configuration to controlled values.

fields.allowable_values: DAY; GTC; IOC; FOK; GTD; AT_OPEN; AT_CLOSE; GOOD_FOR_SESSION
fields.description: Supported time-in-force values.
fields.name: time_in_force_values
fields.transform_logic: Store controlled values as delimited text or model in a bridge table for normalized design.

fields.description: Indicates whether limit_price must be supplied.
fields.name: requires_limit_price
fields.transform_logic: Map configured rule.

fields.description: Indicates whether stop_price must be supplied.
fields.name: requires_stop_price
fields.transform_logic: Map configured rule.

fields.description: Indicates whether the order type supports reserve or displayed quantity.
fields.name: supports_display_quantity
fields.transform_logic: Map boolean to Y/N.

fields.description: Indicates whether a peg offset is supported.
fields.name: supports_peg_offset
fields.transform_logic: Map boolean to Y/N.

fields.allowable_values: PRE_OPEN; OPENING_AUCTION; CONTINUOUS; CLOSING_AUCTION; POST_CLOSE; VOLATILITY_AUCTION
fields.description: Session phases in which the order may be entered or executed.
fields.name: eligible_session_phases
fields.transform_logic: Store controlled values as delimited text or normalize to a bridge table.

fields.description: Summary of price/time or venue-specific priority treatment.
fields.name: execution_priority_summary
fields.transform_logic: Maintain from venue rules and internal product definition.

fields.description: Venue for which the order type is available.
fields.name: venue_code
fields.remark: For venue-specific availability, recommended natural key is order_type_code plus venue_code.
fields.transform_logic: Map native venue code. Null only for a global generic definition.

fields.description: Market segment for availability.
fields.name: market_segment
fields.transform_logic: Standardize segment code.

fields.description: Availability status.
fields.name: availability_status
fields.transform_logic: Map source status.

fields.description: First business date of availability.
fields.name: effective_from_date
fields.transform_logic: Cast to DATE.

fields.description: Last business date of availability.
fields.name: effective_to_date
fields.transform_logic: Null for currently available order type.

fields.description: Originating configuration or venue-rule source.
fields.name: source_system
fields.transform_logic: Populate from mastering lineage.

fields.description: Unique identifier for the effective exchange-rate record.
fields.name: exchange_rate_id
fields.transform_logic: Use source identifier or deterministic hash of business_date, from_currency, to_currency, rate_type, rate_timestamp and provider.

fields.description: Business date for which the rate is applicable.
fields.name: business_date
fields.transform_logic: Cast to DATE using the approved rate cut-off.

fields.description: Currency being converted.
fields.name: from_currency
fields.transform_logic: Uppercase and validate against currency master.

fields.description: Currency into which the amount is converted.
fields.name: to_currency
fields.transform_logic: Uppercase and validate against currency master.

fields.allowable_values: SPOT; CLOSING; OPENING; AVERAGE; ACCOUNTING; RISK; REGULATORY; CUSTOM
fields.description: Purpose or market convention of the rate.
fields.name: rate_type
fields.transform_logic: Map provider code to controlled taxonomy.

fields.description: Multiplier converting one unit of from_currency into to_currency.
fields.name: exchange_rate
fields.remark: Converted amount = source amount multiplied by exchange_rate.
fields.transform_logic: Store as to_currency units per 1 from_currency unit.

fields.description: Risk haircut applicable to the currency conversion.
fields.name: haircut_rate
fields.transform_logic: Select effective approved haircut by currency pair, rate type and business date; default only under explicit policy.

fields.description: Explains how the haircut is applied.
fields.name: haircut_basis
fields.transform_logic: Map policy basis to controlled values.

fields.description: Exchange rate after applying a reduce-value haircut.
fields.name: adjusted_exchange_rate
fields.remark: Use only for the stated haircut basis.
fields.transform_logic: When haircut_basis = REDUCE_CONVERTED_VALUE, exchange_rate * (1 - haircut_rate); otherwise null.

fields.description: Reciprocal rate from to_currency to from_currency.
fields.name: inverse_exchange_rate
fields.remark: Guard against zero, which is disallowed.
fields.transform_logic: 1 / exchange_rate.

fields.description: UTC timestamp at which the quoted rate was observed or fixed.
fields.name: rate_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Convert source timestamp to UTC.

fields.description: Start of rate validity.
fields.name: valid_from_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Use provider effective time or approved cut-off.

fields.description: End of rate validity.
fields.name: valid_to_timestamp
fields.transform_logic: Null for current effective rate until superseded.

fields.description: Name or code of the rate provider.
fields.name: rate_provider
fields.transform_logic: Standardize provider name/code.

fields.description: Provider-assigned rate identifier.
fields.name: source_rate_id
fields.transform_logic: Preserve source identifier.

fields.description: Indicates whether the rate is an official published fixing.
fields.name: is_official_rate
fields.transform_logic: Map source boolean to Y/N.

fields.description: Quality and approval status of the rate.
fields.name: quality_status
fields.transform_logic: Use highest-severity validation and approval result.

fields.description: Originating market-data or risk source.
fields.name: source_system
fields.transform_logic: Populate from lineage metadata.
